name: git-gud
description: Prepare to code. A Souls-like for your terminal: YOU DIED when a command fails, runes for every edit, a bloodstain to retrieve, BONFIRE LIT on commit, and messages from other Tarnished.

hardcore.title: Hardcore mode
hardcore.description: Every failed command kills you, even a grep that found nothing.

speak.title: Announce deaths aloud
speak.description: Say "You died" with the system voice when you die (macOS `say`).

messages.title: Messages from other players
messages.description: Show a soapstone message when a session starts.
